The  Central  Bank  may,  in  consultation  with  the

(4)
An assignment of debts to the Central Bank under
this Part of this Act shall be effected by an instrument which
shall be in such form as may be determined by the Governing
Board.

(5)
The  Central  Bank  shall,  on  the  execution  of  an
assignment, have a first charge on the debts so assigned.

(6)
The provisions of this Part of this Act shall have
effect notwithstanding anything to the contrary in any other
provision of this Act.

90.
No Stamp Duty shall be chargeable or payable on
or in respect of any instrument of assignment of debt by way
of pledge to the Central Bank under this Part of this Act.

91.
No instrument of assignment to the Central Bank
under this Part of this Act shall require registration under the
Registration of Documents Ordinance (Chapter 117).
